reason: In testRecoveryKeysSetupAndLogin (BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorageTest, patch lines 518-524), a new TestAppHelper calls only startLogin() and then logout() without ever calling completeLogin(). Its refreshToken is therefore null when TestAppHelper.java:106 calls oauth.doLogout(refreshToken), and the test does not assert the result, so the logout does nothing and the failure goes unnoticed.
